steps.name: precheck-retained-task79-surface
args: CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS ecaz; SELECT now() AS captured_at, current_database() AS database_name, version() AS postgres_version; SELECT count(*) AS corpus_rows FROM task79_aws_rabitq_k3_block16_tg96_b0_corpus; SELECT count(*) AS query_rows FROM task79_aws_rabitq_k3_block16_tg96_b0_queries; SELECT i.relname AS index_name, am.amname, pg_size_pretty(pg_relation_size(i.oid)) AS index_size, i.reloptions FROM pg_index x JOIN pg_class i ON i.oid = x.indexrelid JOIN pg_class t ON t.oid = x.indrelid JOIN pg_am am ON am.oid = i.relam WHERE t.relname = 'task79_aws_rabitq_k3_block16_tg96_b0_corpus' ORDER BY i.relname; SELECT name, setting, context FROM pg_settings WHERE name IN ('ec_spire.leaf_block_rows', 'ec_spire.leaf_block_pruning_max_blocks_per_leaf', 'ec_spire.leaf_block_pruning_max_global_blocks', 'ec_spire.leaf_block_pruning_global_probe_blocks', 'ec_spire.leaf_block_pruning_sample_rows_per_block', 'ec_spire.leaf_block_pruning_sample_summary_prior_weight', 'ec_spire.leaf_block_pruning_summary_radius_weight', 'ec_spire.leaf_block_pruning_route_prior_weight', 'ec_spire.max_routing_expansions', 'ec_spire.nprobe', 'ec_spire.rerank_width') ORDER BY name;
